title: Humboldt Bay Maritime Museum

services.name: Madaket Cruises
services.desc: Step Aboard! Learn the history of Humboldt Bay during an 8.5-mile cruise along the shores of the bay while the captain explains local history, industries, activities, points of interest and wildlife. Seals are sure to be seen along with migratory birds, the Fishermen's Statue and the iconic Carson Mansion. Venture to the unchartered waters of Arcata Bay to experience close encounters with the creatures that call these waters home. blurb: The humboldt bay maritime museum was founded in 1977. William Zerlang, a long time collector of marine artifact, and a group of colleagues sought to establish a local museum to preserve the rich maritime heritage of the entire humboldt bay region.
